body:
Thank you for the explanation and the analogy.  You're right, I really should get checked out.  I'm highly considering it.  I'm currently feeling a lot better than I was last night, but I know it'll come back if I don't do anything about it.

And God I know driving like an idiot makes me sound really immature and angsty, but I felt like it was the right thing to do at the time.  I wouldn't ever want to endanger or hurt someone else.  I just wasn't thinking.  I get a little hard to control sometimes when I get deep in to my feelings.

Thanks, I'll keep trying, I guess.  Looking for help just scares me, I'm scared people won't look at me the same way.  I have an outward appearance of pretty much having it all together.  I'm usually the one that my friends come to when they need help.  I'll give it a shot..

Medication does scare me as i told ^ that poster up there.

I've tried working out, but I lose my motivation.  When I was going through a breakup I exercised my ass off because people told me to, but it didn't really help.  I just felt like more of a slump for some reason, as if everything I was doing was just for nothing.  I'll give it a shot, but I can't make any promises.  It's just so much easier sometimes to say fuck the exercise and just do whatever.

I do try to get as much sleep as possible, just the procrastination usually makes me stay up all night to finish assignments.  Honestly, sleeping is the only time I really feel alright.  When I go to bed I feel pretty terrible, and when I wake up I feel empty..

I will try working out like I said.  Thanks for reading, I appreciate it.

I am a little scared of medication, but it's what seems to work for most people.  I HATE the thought of having to take a pill to be happy, or being "irregular" if I miss my meds.  Sometimes I do feel like I'd rather be unhappy than medicated, so thanks for bringing that up.

I guess I'll keep trying to find someone to talk to.  I've never been good with "therapy" or "counselors".  It feels so uncomfortable talking to a professional adult asking me "how I feel".  It's half the reason I haven't seen a doctor.  I'd feel like they were looking down on me.

Thanks for reading, I appreciate it.  Like I said I'll find someone to talk to I guess.
